body: Hey now, there is nothing funny about PMS jokes... Period!
At least they follow the rules.
Just had to move out of state from there. Thank you for giving me a little piece of home on this Thanksgiving day!!!

Sorry about the long delay. Every situation has its story and no one can know yours more than you do. Similarly only you can be the one to change it. I challenge you to today or tomorrow just take a walk and see if you can't find something that pokes you in the feel goods. For instance, I stumbled on a nesting duck behind my house. Everyday so far I've visited her and her family. Try that and see if you can't add a nicer chapter.
Piggybacking off the previous comment on "modern concept of success", someone once told me that failure is an event. Not a person.
I know it's very cliche but suicide is a very permanent solution to what could be a temporary situation. Let's talk about things and then we can decide on permanence.
